title: Migrate project packaging and workflows to Poetry
description: Convert Biblicus project dependency and tooling workflows to Poetry, update docs/scripts/CI references, and validate with test/lint commands.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Started Poetry migration task. Next steps: inspect current pyproject/build backend/dependency groups and scripts, convert to Poetry-managed dependency declaration, add/update poetry.lock, and update docs/automation commands. Will run lint/tests after migration and record results.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Implemented Poetry migration updates: switched build backend to poetry-core, moved dev dependencies to [tool.poetry.group.dev.dependencies], retained project dependencies/extras, added Poetry package source mapping, and generated poetry.lock. Updated CI/release workflows to use Poetry install/build/run commands. Updated primary contributor docs to use poetry install/run. Validation: poetry check (pass), poetry install --with dev (pass), poetry run ruff check src/biblicus/ (pass), poetry run biblicus --help (pass), poetry install --with dev --extras datasets (pass), poetry run python tests/fixtures/fetch_wikitext2.py (pass), poetry run python scripts/test.py (pass).
